items.title: Billy Taylor — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: I love what they did with Hart Silver and Herbie Hancock and many other pianists who played for them.

ctx.x: Do you think also your knowledge of the business may have prevented you… made other people gun shy in dealing with you?

Yeah. It became very apparent, very early in my career that you couldn’t do, and I don’t say this to put anybody down at Bluenote but Bluenote had a way of handling musicians, which I didn’t see eye to eye with. I mean I love what they did. I love what they did with Hart Silver and Herbie Hancock and many other pianists who played for them. But they didn’t do very much for Walter Bishop or for some of the other pianists that they could have done with at that time.
